Oliver —

Appreciate the questionnaire. We answered inline below and attached a short evidence pack with our SOC2 summary and a retention matrix. High level summary up front:

- Residency: Hosted API runs in region(s) selected at tenant creation; production data is stored in the cloud region you select. For EU-only tenancy we run infrastructure in eu-west-1; for US customers we default to us-west-2. Data processed in transit may traverse regional endpoints for routing but persistent storage is region-bound per tenant.
- Retention: Default "active" retention is 90 days for the hosted API request/response artifacts. Customers can request shorter windows or enable ephemeral mode (7 days or less) on enterprise plans. Logs required for billing and audit are retained up to 365 days by default; retention can be shortened by contract.
- Deletion: We support tenant-level erasure and document-level deletion. Deletions are queued and processed within 72 hours; backups and snapshots are purged on a 30–90 day cadence depending on backup type (snapshots: 30 days, long-term backup stores: 90 days). We provide a deletion attestation report on request.

Attached: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, tenant-retention-matrix.xlsx, data-deletion-flow.png

Full inline answers follow (we labeled your Qs). If you want a brief call to walk through the flow, Marissa can join for the operational runbook.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Oliver,

Adding a couple of operational details that often come up in reviews:

1) Regional Isolation: Tenant data is logically isolated and encrypted with tenant keys. For customers who require customer-managed keys we integrate with KMS offerings (AWS KMS/HSM). For true data residency guarantees (region-lock), we offer contractual addenda to ensure write/read endpoints are constrained to a specific region and cross-region backups are disabled.

2) Deletion Mechanics: When a delete request is initiated we remove primary copies and cascade purges to caches and KV-layer within 72 hours. Snapshot lifecycle is managed by our backup service; snapshots older than the snapshot retention window are automatically cleaned. For urgent erasures we offer an expedited path (SLA-backed) as a paid add-on — we supply a signed attestation once complete.

3) Evidence & Audit Logs: Audit logs (who-initiated-delete, API keys used, request IDs) are retained by default for 180 days and are available in the console; exports to S3 or your logging pipeline are available for longer-term retention.

I'll attach a diagram of the deletion flow and a retention matrix. Happy to redact operational IP for the RFP.

Best,
